title: Multiple stack-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities exist in the boa formIpv6Setup static network configuration functionality of Totolink X2000R… (CVE-2026-42021)
description: Multiple stack-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities exist in the boa formIpv6Setup static network configuration functionality of Totolink X2000R firmware TOTOLINK-X2000R-Gh-V1.0.0-B20250421.1327. These vulnerabilities can be triggered by an authenticated HTTP request targeting the static_dns1 parameter, potentially allowing arbitrary code execution. The CVSS score is 9.1, indicating critical severity.
aiSummary: The Totolink X2000R device running firmware TOTOLINK-X2000R-Gh-V1.0.0-B20250421.1327 contains multiple stack-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities in the boa web server's formIpv6Setup static network configuration functionality. Specifically, the static_dns1 parameter in an authenticated HTTP request can be exploited to cause a buffer overflow, leading to arbitrary code execution. The vulnerabilities are identified as CWE-121 (stack-based buffer overflow). No patch or remediation information is provided in the source data.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation allows an authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the affected device, potentially leading to full compromise including confidentiality, integrity, and availability impacts. The CVSS vector indicates network attack vector with low attack complexity, requiring high privileges but no user interaction, and results in complete system compromise.
